pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Blood Ape General is an enormous and exceptionally violent demon beast dwelling within ancient forests. Possessing immense physical strength, it can shatter rock and overwhelm lesser cultivators through sheer force. It favors shadowed woodland and is rarely seen, revealing itself most often beneath darkness.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found in jungles and dark forests, on dirt, moss, or stone. Requires nighttime or a covered sky. Has an additional 1-in-8 spawn check.
